title: fix(console): a stage move refused with a 409 in a record drawer re-reads the record
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbVF7sWPNE4HmjkgyaVxQYif)_
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jRaJbQ4vqdv4J5peqA

Fixes #36309

Clause-②: yes (widening) — measured: the claim expected `no`; `RecordContextValue` gains the optional member `reread` (built `dist/context/RecordContext.d.ts` carries `reread?: () => void | Promise<void>;`, exported through `@object-ui/react`'s root); nothing removed or renamed. The seat amends the claim.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:在列表抽屉(以及记录页上打开的抽屉)里改阶段被「别人刚改过」拒绝后,记录会重新读取,再点一次「移动」就能成功;抽屉里依旧没有「刷新」按钮,整页记录页不变。
- 为什么做:修的是阶段菜单在抽屉里的一个缺陷(之前只修好了整页),属于记录页阶段推进这条线。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是抽屉里阶段被拒后仍要关掉抽屉重开才能移动,和改前一样;改动可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无

## What changes

The card's step 1, measured: the record header's stage menu **does** draw in a drawer. `RecordDetailView` mounts the header's stage slot with no `embedded` gate, and the new pin below finds the menu trigger, opens it and writes a Move in an `embedded` view. The "split preview" no longer exists (`NavigationOverlayMode` lists `page | drawer | new_window | none`; the split face retired), so the embedded surfaces today are the list's record drawer (`objectViewRecordOverlay`'s `RecordStackDrawer`, and `NavigationOverlay` in `ObjectDataPage` / `InterfaceListPage`) and the drawer a record page opens over itself (`RecordPageDrawerHost`). All mount `RecordDetailView` with `embedded`.

Step 2, as ruled ("separate 'show a refresh button' from 're-read the record' instead of overloading `refresh`"):

- `@object-ui/react` — `RecordContextValue` gains `reread`, the record re-read with no affordance of its own; `refresh` is documented as what it is, the host's opt-in to the header's Refresh entry. `reread` joins the provider's memo dep list.
- `@object-ui/plugin-detail` — the stage path (`useStageChange`, shared by the header's `RecordStageMenu` and `record:path`'s stage press) re-reads after a move and after a 409 through `ctx.reread`, and through `ctx.refresh` when the host gives no `reread` (so a host that provides only `refresh` behaves as before).
- `@object-ui/app-shell` — `RecordDetailView` hands the header's provider `reread` on the page and in a drawer alike (the same `'*'` notice the Refresh entry publishes: a 409 is a write this client never saw); `refresh` stays `undefined` when embedded, so the drawer still draws no Refresh entry. On the record page the stage path's behaviour is byte-for-byte what it was.

## Tests

- New block `RecordDetailView.embeddedStageReread-36309` in the shared harness `RecordDetailView.harness.test.tsx` (the file's rule for new `RecordDetailView` pins):
  - in a drawer, a 409 on Move re-reads the record and the second Move carries the new version (`ifMatch` of read 2);
  - CONTROL: the drawer draws no Refresh entry;
  - CONTROL: on the record page the same 409 re-reads, the second Move carries the new version, and the Refresh entry is still offered.
- Red on the base before the fix (commit 4253dfd7, test only): `× in a drawer, a 409 on Move re-reads the record …` failing at the `findOne` second-call assertion; both controls green. Green after.
- Fixture spelling: `RecordStageMenu-35891.test.tsx` and `record-path.stageChange-28199.test.tsx` handed the stage path `refresh={refresh}`; they now hand `reread={refresh}` (they only used the member the path called).
- New block in `RecordStageMenu-35891.test.tsx` (`#36309 a host with only refresh still re-reads; reread wins where both are given`): a provider with only `refresh` calls it after a 409 on Move; CONTROL: with both, `reread` is called and `refresh` is not.
- `RecordContext.valueShape.pin.test.tsx` lists `reread` (its compile-time half red the react type-check until it did, which is the pin working).

## Acceptance notes

- `RecordContextProvider` has two other producers, `RecordDetailPanel` (the board/calendar record panel) and `recordBinding`; neither passed `refresh`, so neither re-read after a stage write before, and neither draws a stage surface that writes (the panel draws the inline save bar, which takes its own `refresh` prop; the binding is `canEdit={false}`). Unchanged.
- No narrowing: a host that passes only `refresh` keeps its re-read (the stage path falls back to it); `reread` is the added, optional member. Within this repo `RecordDetailView` is the only producer of either.
- `content/docs/frontend/` and the react README document no `RecordContext` member, so there is no docs page to update.
- Overlap: `overlap-check.mjs` clean against #36343 (shares `RecordDetailView.tsx`) and #36316 (shares the stage files; it adds no `refresh` call there).

## Verification

Read first: `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/recordPathStageChange.tsx` (the four `reread` calls), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` (`headerReread` beside `headerRefresh`), `ui/packages/react/src/context/RecordContext.tsx` (the two members' contract).

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.harness.test.tsx -t embeddedStageReread` — expect 3 passed.

Browser screenshot: NOT MEASURED (no dev app driven in this run; the harness pin renders the real `RecordDetailView` embedded).
